params.textField: We have found selective receptors for adrenaline, and that helps decrease the side effects of our medications. So if you wanted to affect a limited number of organs, one would choose a selective medication. If you needed to affect the heart rate, you would choose a medication that only affected the *Beta 1 receptor*.  If you needed to affect the diameter of the airways in the lungs, you would use a medication that bound to the *Beta 2 receptor* If you needed to affect the pupils of the eyes, you would use a medication that bound to the *Alpha 1 receptor*. Interestingly, we are finding subsets of these subsets, which will make it even more difficult for future students.

params.textField: (Part 2 of the same theme) We have found selective receptors for adrenaline, and that helps decrease the side effects of our medications. So if you wanted to affect a limited number of organs, one would choose a selective medication. If you needed to affect the mast cells, stabilizing them (especially good for lung problems), you would use a medication that bound to the *Beta 2 receptor* If you needed to affect the peripheral blood vessels, to affect blood pressure in that way (as opposed to affecting the blood pressure through effects on the heart), you would use a medication that bound to the *Alpha 1 receptor*.  If you needed to affect the heart contractility, you would choose a medication that only affected the *Beta 1 receptor*. Once you get the hang of this, it is pretty easy, so just practice with these and other activities, and you will have it down pat.

params.textField: Now that you have a general idea of what the individual receptors do, try applying this knowledge to agonists vs antagonists. If a medication was giving a decrease in blood pressure upon standing (orthostatic hypotension) it may indeed be a *alpha 1 antagonist*. If the client’s heart needed to be stimulated they may receive a *beta 1 agonist*. One medication that is never used is a selective *beta 2 antagonist* because there is never a time that one would want to selectively constrict the airways.
